title: AI-based Intrusion Detection System for VANET
summary: A deep-learning intrusion detection system for vehicular ad-hoc networks that classifies DoS, Sybil, and Wormhole attacks using CNN-LSTM and autoencoder models. A separate CTGAN.py script uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata to generate synthetic tabular attack data for training.
evidence: CTGAN.py:39-49 uses `from sdv.single_table import CTGANSynthesizer` and `model = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata); model.fit(df1)`
